title_ru: Методы коннектомно-ограниченного моделирования нейродинамики Drosophila и переноса представлений в физически обоснованные модели ECAP для адаптивной спинальной нейростимуляции
title_en: Connectome-constrained modelling of Drosophila neural dynamics and representation transfer to physically grounded ECAP models for adaptive spinal cord stimulation

chain: separate human ECAP physical observation model

scientific_problem: This project asks whether constraints learned from a Drosophila connectome add measurable value to human ECAP/SCS modelling beyond human-only and randomized synthetic controls; the reviewed prior art and current data access do not establish that contribution.
object: Neural dynamics and evoked electrophysiological responses under external stimulation.
subject: Methods for connectome-constrained simulation, representation transfer, and physical ECAP observation in adaptive SCS tasks.
goal: Develop and falsifiably evaluate a two-model method in which Drosophila connectome dynamics constrain a transferable representation and a separate physical operator maps human neural recruitment to ECAP for an SCS task.

hypothesis.text: A representation pretrained on biologically constrained Drosophila neural dynamics, when connected to a separately validated ECAP observation model, improves a predeclared human ECAP/SCS metric over human-only, degree-preserving rewired-connectome ensemble with shared initialization, shuffled-dynamics, and naive-synthetic controls without worsening calibration.

actuality.text: Whole adult Drosophila brain-and-cord connectomes now support circuit-scale computational models.
Human ECAP provides an objective neural-recruitment signal but is not a direct pain measure.
Synthetic pain domain adaptation already exists, so synthetic pretraining alone cannot constitute novelty.
Existing SCS-response prediction does not establish a Drosophila-to-ECAP transfer chain.

tasks.text: Construct and validate a bounded Drosophila nociceptive-dynamics simulator.
Define the transferable state and randomized biological controls.
Implement the independent ECAP forward/measurement model.
Evaluate transfer on subject-level human ECAP data.
Evaluate an SCS programming task and calibration against baselines.
Conditionally evaluate clinical response only with linked outcome data.

novelty_claims.text: Candidate method: a two-model Drosophila-dynamics and human-ECAP bridge with an explicit physical observation operator.
Candidate experiment: isolate biological contribution using degree-preserving rewired-connectome ensemble with shared initialization, shuffled-dynamics, naive-synthetic, and human-only controls.
Candidate system result: uncertainty-aware SCS parameter estimation that abstains outside the validated ECAP domain.

defense_propositions.text: Candidate proposition: a versioned Drosophila simulator would reproduce prespecified neural and defensive-behavior observables under compatible primary stimuli; this has not been tested in this project.
defense_propositions.falsification_experiment: TODO EXP-01: frozen graph, stimulus/target compatibility, locked synthetic-family split and graph-null controls; no execution until input STOP reopens.

defense_propositions.text: Candidate proposition: a separately calibrated physical ECAP operator would reproduce prespecified waveform, latency and recruitment characteristics on independent human recordings; this has not been tested in this project.
defense_propositions.falsification_experiment: TODO EXP-02: source-matched montage and artifact chain, held-out participants/configurations, registered waveform and calibration tolerances.

defense_propositions.text: Candidate proposition: any incremental contribution of connectome-derived pretraining would have to survive registered human-only, naive-synthetic and graph-null comparisons on held-out participants without worse calibration; no gain has been demonstrated.
defense_propositions.falsification_experiment: TODO EXP-03 and EXP-04: matched comparison arms, one frozen primary score, participant-level inference and calibration with leakage controls; no execution until data and input STOPs reopen.

falsification: Reject the simulator claim if it fails predefined fly activity or behavior observables.
Reject the ECAP-like claim if waveform/latency/recruitment tolerances fail on human ECAP.
Reject the transfer hypothesis if the primary metric does not improve or calibration worsens.
Do not make a clinical-response claim without linked longitudinal SCS outcomes.
forbidden_claims: Drosophila simulation represents subjective human pain.
The fly nervous system is a direct digital twin of the human spinal cord.
ECAP is a direct measure of pain.
Simulation-only results prove clinical SCS effectiveness.

specialty_alignment.specialty: 2.2.12 Приборы, системы и изделия медицинского назначения
specialty_alignment.boundary: These directions are candidate alignments for a medical signal measurement, physical ECAP model, and SCS control method. Software implementation or a proposed protocol alone is not an obtained scientific result; directions involving clinical prediction or treatment benefit require separately authorized patient-level evidence. The mapping is a proposal and has no author or supervisor acceptance.
